name: Official Predictor and Link-Fidelity Evaluation
purpose: Evaluate frozen classical and learned predictors once on untouched official WOMD validation and quantify both trajectory and communication-state fidelity.
work_items: load official validation without tuning or adaptation
evaluate every final checkpoint and classical predictor per scenario
evaluate communication-state fidelity from predicted geometry
compute predictor rankings under geometric and communication metrics
acceptance_criteria: official validation is untouched by hyperparameter/model selection
all canonical learned objectives and seeds are evaluated
trajectory and communication rankings can be compared directly
calibration parameters, if any, were fit only on development
no official-held-out rerun is used to change the selected model
forbidden: reselecting checkpoints after seeing official metrics
aggregating away scenario IDs before final statistics
blocking_reason: Requires a separately exported official WOMD validation dataset and a frozen 20-checkpoint archive.
